digest.component_or_area: module-size gate enforcement and file refactoring
propositions: Six uncovered files in src/rebar are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap (inbound_differ.py, apply_inbound_records.py, det_floor.py, executor.py, prompts.py, init.py), causing CI build failures when any edit—including comments—is added.
The 800-LOC limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked and cannot be raised; any file at 799+ LOC blocks further edits and creates latent CI failures for subsequent contributors.

Splits must follow existing logical concerns and architectural boundaries in the call graph, target 200-500 LOC per resulting file, and leave real headroom below 720 LOC to avoid recreating the same problem.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) is now uncovered after in-flight work closed, making it an additional target requiring extraction along a seam rather than mechanical line-carving.
